note: Executable workflow registry. Entries define canonical responsibilities and IDs; implementation remains independently reviewable. Runtime stays disabled until the corresponding gate is homologated.

workflows.name: Ingress Orchestrator
workflows.purpose: Normalizar mensagem, envelope de evento e correlação; produzir message_received.

workflows.name: Identity & Event Context
workflows.purpose: Resolver contato, sessão, evento ativo/novo e entrada não comercial; produzir contact_identified/event_context_opened.

workflows.name: Acquisition Attribution
workflows.purpose: Registrar landing, campanha, serviço e UTM/touchpoint; produzir landing_source_detected.

workflows.name: Fact Extraction & Commit
workflows.purpose: Extrair, normalizar, validar e versionar fatos; produzir facts_committed/conflict.

workflows.name: Quote Engine
workflows.purpose: Executar readiness, localidade e pricing determinístico; produzir quote_generated/quote_ready.

workflows.name: Quote Presentation
workflows.purpose: Apresentar quote, qualificar evento e mover estágio para ORCAMENTO; produzir quote_sent.

workflows.name: Commercial Decision Router
workflows.purpose: Classificar decisão semântica em choices autorizadas e propor estado/ação.

workflows.name: Human Handoff
workflows.purpose: Criar e gerir human_lock e human_task; produzir lock enabled/released.

workflows.name: Response Composer
workflows.purpose: Compor texto curto a partir de ação autorizada, fatos e templates; produzir response_candidate.

workflows.name: Response Guard & Dispatch
workflows.purpose: Aplicar segurança, janela e SEND_ENABLED; produzir sent/shadow.

workflows.name: Trello Commercial Projection
workflows.purpose: Criar/mover/atualizar card Comercial somente a partir do estado canônico; produzir trello_projection_updated.

workflows.name: Trello Human Actions
workflows.purpose: Transformar webhook Trello em comando humano validado por Guard.

workflows.name: Follow-up Controller
workflows.purpose: Agendar, cancelar ou despachar follow-up permitido; produzir eventos de followup.

workflows.name: Closing Intake
workflows.purpose: Receber intenção/formulário de fechamento e registrar dados; produzir closing_form_received.

workflows.name: Contract Lifecycle
workflows.purpose: Gerar, enviar e sincronizar contrato Autentique; produzir contract events.

workflows.name: Payment Intake & Verification
workflows.purpose: Extrair comprovante, comparar e solicitar verificação humana; produzir payment events.

workflows.name: Win & Operations Handoff
workflows.purpose: Verificar critério GANHO, reserva e projeção Logística; produzir event_won.

workflows.name: Art Lifecycle
workflows.purpose: Gerir briefing, draft, decisão e revisão humana de arte; produzir art events.

workflows.name: Logistics & Pre-event
workflows.purpose: Gerir checklist, equipe, segurança e readiness sem alterar a estrutura protegida do board Logística.

workflows.name: Event Execution Closure
workflows.purpose: Registrar início, conclusão ou cancelamento operacional do evento.

workflows.name: Delivery
workflows.purpose: Localizar pasta/link OneDrive e gerir entrega pós-evento; produzir delivery events.

workflows.name: Post-sale
workflows.purpose: Gerir confirmação, avaliação e consentimento após entrega.

workflows.name: Campaign & Remarketing
workflows.purpose: Segmentar, criar snapshot, exigir aprovação e despachar campanha elegível.

workflows.name: Audit Watchdog
workflows.purpose: Detectar inconsistências, vencimentos e estados impossíveis; produzir alerts/tasks.

workflows.name: Replay & Shadow Evaluator
workflows.purpose: Reexecutar fixtures/corpus e comparar candidatos em shadow; produzir shadow_evaluated.
